newsitem.title: CHINA: Two explosions reported in western China city.
newsitem.headline: Two explosions reported in western China city.

text.p: Two explosions blew up two buses on Tuesday in the city of Urumqi, capital of China's mainly Moslem restive western region of Xinjiang, local residents said.
The blasts occurred at about 6.30 p.m. (1030 GMT) but it was not immediately known whether anyone was injured in the explosions, said residents reached by telephone.
"The situation is very tense," said one police officer. He declined to give further details.
One explosion occurred on Northwest Road, involving a vehicle believed to be a minibus, and the second was on a road closer to the city centre, one resident said.
The roads were blocked for about one hour but normal traffic has since resumed, resident said.
